description: This Java source file defines a generic class `CommandHandlerRegistry` that manages registration and execution of command handlers, each associated with a key. It uses a map of handlers and provides methods to register new handlers and execute them with provided parameters.

classes.name: CommandHandlerRegistry
classes.description: A generic registry class for storing and executing command handlers mapped by keys

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a handler for a given key

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the handler associated with the given key using provided parameters, throws specified exception if no handler found
